Guto Harri

Series 1, Episode 6

The Episode

Join Abbie Bennington at The Savoy as she uncorks a fascinating, candid conversation with Guto Harri. From his extensive career as the BBC's Chief Political Correspondent to his time deep within the inner sanctum of Number 10 as Director of Communications for Boris Johnson, Guto has been at the forefront of modern British political history.

About Guto Harri

Guto Harri is a Welsh broadcaster, writer and communications adviser. He spent much of his BBC career covering UK politics, serving as Chief Political Correspondent at Westminster before postings in Rome and New York. He later held senior communications roles in business and politics, including Director of Communications at Downing Street under Boris Johnson.
